item.description:
Release v5.11.1

Changes since v5.11.0

  • feat(AppIconDesignerPlugin): export Icon Composer packages
  • feat(database): add localization keys for structure editing UI
  • feat(database): add SQL source editor with syntax highlighting
  • feat(database): add staged column schema editing
  • feat(database): add staged index schema editing
  • feat(database): add table structure inspector
  • feat(database): multi-statement execution and query history
  • feat(DatabaseManager): add unified table browser with pagination, inline editing and change tracking
  • feat(DatabaseManagerPlugin): add localization strings for structure inspector
  • feat(debug-badge): move Debug badge to leading toolbar position
  • feat(factory): support custom loading view from host app
  • feat(GitPlugin): add GitStatusBarVisibilityGate to control status bar item visibility
  • feat(MessageList): add real-time elapsed timer for process disclosure
  • feat(workspace): conditionally show layout menu based on view container visibility overrides
  • fix(AppStoreConnectPlugin): remove invalid limit on to-one preReleaseVersion relationship
  • fix(booklet): use leading padding instead of horizontal in explanation view
  • fix(ci): make app version injection location-independent
  • fix(WorkspacePlugin): split chat section divider key at last dot on restore
  • refactor(app-store-connect): route HTTP through kernel network
  • refactor(app-update): route feed requests through kernel network
